Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno from parent CHEMBL1336 to include parent and salts; join child molecules via molregno; join compound_structures on molregno; join compound_records on molregno; join activities on record_id; join assays on assay_id; join target_dictionary on tid. Filter parent CHEMBL1336; target CHEMBL279; standard_type IC50; standard_units nM. Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. No limit.
